assets.name: option-preset
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated raster menu illustration for a modern Mario Party-inspired settings card. Reference is STYLE ONLY, do not reuse the picture frame or star. Match its simple bright pictogram language: large readable silhouette, saturated game colors, restrained two-tone shading, fine white outer edge, no photorealism, no heavy glossy plastic, no texture noise. Subject: three chunky Mario dice blocks, one red, one blue, one yellow, arranged as a compact selectable trio, white pips. Centered square composition filling 80 percent of canvas, entire object visible, generous clean transparent margins. True transparent RGBA background. No text, no panel, no duplicate objects except explicitly requested.
